analysis.title: The great tech liquidation: is 2018 about to repeat?
key_insights: NDX is trading close to make-or-break levels: the long-term trendline from the Liberation Day lows coincides with key levels from last year.

NDX is well below its 200-day moving average. The 21-day average has just crossed below the 200-day (a light death cross). A similar cross earlier this year coincided with local lows, but the March cross last year was followed by the Liberation Day sell-off.

Fundamental long/short funds are still cutting exposure. Gross leverage fell 4.4 points in November to 206.3% (23rd percentile over the past year). Net leverage fell 7.6 points to 41.6%, the lowest in five years.

Hedge funds are net sellers of global equities in November, with long sales outpacing short sales by roughly 3 to 1. The trailing four-week de-grossing is the largest since February 2023 and one of the biggest of the past decade.

Hedge fund selling of global tech over the trailing six weeks is the most aggressive in a decade, at a -4.4 z-score. The global tech long/short ratio fell from a YTD peak of 2.9 to 1.79, approaching 10-year lows.
Net exposure in US Semis & Semi Equip has fallen below net exposure in US Software for the first time since the start of 2026.

Hedge fund exposure to medium-term momentum is on track to fall for a sixth straight month to the lowest level since December 2022 (20th percentile over five years). Value exposure is at five-year highs amid stagflation concerns.
The current tech sell-off closely tracks the autumn 2018 pattern, when NDX lost about 25% from its peak to the late-2018 lows. The report notes the market fell much further than most expected then.

sector_views.rationale: Hedge funds are liquidating global tech at decade-extreme pace, and the report sees a close resemblance to the 2018 sell-off that extended well beyond expectations.

risk_factors: Further NDX downside if the 2018 analogue holds (about 25% peak-to-trough decline).
Break below the Liberation Day trendline and last year's key levels.
Stagflation concerns driving the rotation from momentum into value.

tension_points.bear_case: The sell-off tracks autumn 2018 closely, when NDX fell about 25% from its peak and kept falling much further than most expected. The March cross last year was followed by the Liberation Day sell-off.
tension_points.what_invalidates: NDX breaking the long-term trendline from the Liberation Day lows and last year's key levels would confirm the bear case.
